thread:
Iliana Park: Hey folks — launching the community-localization bundle v0.1.0 today. It includes Spanish and pt-BR quickstarts, localized starter templates, and a translated maintainers checklist. Release assets and notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-locales/releases/tag/v0.1.0 :tada:
open-source-bot: Published release v0.1.0 (community-localization) — assets: localized-quickstarts.zip, templates-es.zip, templates-pt-BR.zip
Samir Gupta: Amazing! Huge thanks to everyone who contributed :heart: — tagging i18n maintainers @Cheng @Elaine
Cheng Li: Thank you! Quick note: Spanish translations completed, but pt-BR has a few placeholder strings left (TODOs in docs/pt-BR). I'll open a small PR to fix them tonight.
Elaine Ramos: On it — I'll handle the website integration for /docs/es and /docs/pt-BR, deploying to staging after PR merges.
Mike O'Connor: Running smoke tests against the localized templates now. If any template fails, I'll post logs here.
Samir Gupta: Let's also export contributor credits for the release. Command I ran locally: `python scripts/generate_credits.py --since 2024-06-01 --output credits/locales-v0.1.0.md`
Iliana Park: FYI, we've added an i18n section to the maintainers handbook and updated CODEOWNERS for the locales/ directory. Please review.
Cheng Li: PR opened: #412 (placeholder fixes + small copy edits). Also added a short eval prompt set for es to validate generation quality for localized examples.
open-source-bot: CI checks: build ✅, lint ✅, i18n-smoke-tests ✅ — release artifacts attached.
Mike O'Connor: smoke test: templates-es failed on template-render for header component (render error). Logs: https://ci.internal/reports/1799997777/logs. Pushing a patch branch now.
Iliana Park: Thanks Mike — assigning @Mike O'Connor and @Cheng Li to the fix. Holding a 30min i18n office hours tomorrow 16:00 UTC to triage any remaining issues; calendar invite incoming.
Samir Gupta: I'll send invites to core-maintainers and the #community-contributors channel. Also planning a short walkthrough video for maintainers.
Elaine Ramos: Can we add a "How to volunteer to translate" blurb to the release notes? I can draft a 2-paragraph guide and a CONTRIBUTING section.
Iliana Park: Please do. Draft into /docs/community/locales/README.md and ping me when ready. I'll also draft a short blog post for next week highlighting contributors and linking to the release.
Samir Gupta: :party_parrot: Congrats team — really proud of this first wave.
Mike O'Connor: Patch merged, re-running smoke tests. Will update once staging finishes.
Cheng Li: Minor follow-up: added a note in the PR about pluralization edge-cases for pt-BR, would love a native review when possible.
Iliana Park: Noted. We'll add a volunteer tag in the release notes so native speakers can help review. Closing thread for announcements, moving ongoing fixes to #eng-infra and #eng-ml as needed.
